content: orafce (github.com/orafce/orafce, formerly okbob/orafce) latest release VERSION_4_16_7, published 2026-06-04 per GitHub API. Packaged for PG17 via apt (postgresql-17-orafce) and dnf (orafce_17). Strong coverage: date/time functions (add_months, last_day, next_day, months_between, trunc/round on date), dbms_output, utl_file (superuser-gated, 10 file/session cap, 32K line max), plvdate/plvstr/plvsubst/plvlex, VARCHAR2/NUMBER-like types, dbms_assert, plunit. Weak/partial coverage: dbms_sql (subset only, no full compatibility -- separate orafce_sql extension exists for a closer dbms_sql API), dbms_alert (missing on some platforms e.g. Greenplum), no dbms_lob/dbms_crypto/utl_smtp equivalents built in. Explicit project goal is 'reduce migration work,' not full Oracle compatibility.
